enrichment.headline: Asks the county for a temporary cash transfer of up to $30 million for 2019-20
enrichment.summary: The Board adopts a resolution asking the Alameda County Treasury for a temporary transfer of funds of up to $30 million. The text says the request is due to ups and downs in the district's revenue and receipts during fiscal year 2019-2020.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Temporary Transfer of Funds - Up To $30 Million - Fiscal Year 2019-2020 - County of Alameda Treasury - Chief Financial Officer

enrichment.headline: Sets up temporary transfers between district funds for fiscal year 2019-2020
enrichment.summary: The Board adopts a resolution to establish temporary interfund transfers, which move money between district funds, for fiscal year 2019-2020. The text does not state a dollar amount.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Temporary Interfund Transfers - Fiscal Year 2019-2020 - Chief Financial Officer

enrichment.headline: Hires FM3 Research for up to $33,000 to survey voters on a possible 2020 facilities bond
enrichment.summary: The district hires FM3 Research of Oakland to run a public opinion survey of district voters about a potential 2020 General Obligation Bond for modernizing district facilities. The agreement runs from August 29, 2019 through June 30, 2020. It is paid from the Special Reserve for Capital Outlay Projects fund.

vendor.name: FM3 Research (Fairbank, Maslin, Maullin, Metz and Associates)

items.fundingSource: Fund 40 - Special Reserve for Capital Outlay Projects
items.group: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: General Services Agreement - FM3 Research - Facilities Planning & Management Department

enrichment.headline: Amends the 1000 Broadway office lease, with monthly rent rising to $250,695.76 by 2021-22
enrichment.summary: This is the fourth amendment to the lease for the district's central administrative offices at 1000 Broadway in Oakland. Monthly base rent is set for three lease years from September 1, 2019 through August 31, 2022, plus the district's share of increases in taxes and operating expenses starting January 1, 2020. The text does not give one total; the highest stated monthly rent is shown.

items.group: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
items.title: Fourth Amendment, Office Lease - Sparknight, LLC - Central Administrative Offices - 1000 Broadway, Oakland, CA

enrichment.headline: Adds $5,000 to Siegfried Engineering's design contract for the Westlake Middle School field project
enrichment.summary: The district adds design (architectural) services for an extra basketball court retrofit, a drinking fountain, court striping and painting of seat walls at Westlake Middle School. This raises the contract limit from $85,902.68 to $90,902.68. All other terms stay the same.

items.group: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Amendment No. 3, Agreement for Architectural Services - Siegfried Engineering, Inc. - Westlake Middle School Field Project

enrichment.headline: Approves a new or revised job description for Truck Driver
enrichment.summary: The Board adopts a resolution creating or revising the job description for the Truck Driver position. The text does not state a dollar amount.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Creation/Revision of Job Description - Truck Driver - Talent/Human Resources Department

enrichment.headline: Adopts Personnel Report No. 1920-0002
enrichment.summary: The Board adopts the Talent department's Personnel Report No. 1920-0002. The text does not list the individual personnel actions or any dollar amounts.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Personnel Report No. 1920-0002 - Talent/Human Resources Department

enrichment.headline: Partners with Academy of Art University to train art teachers in district classrooms at no cost
enrichment.summary: The district signs a memorandum of understanding (MOU) and interagency agreement with Academy of Art University for practica, which are classroom teaching placements, for K-12 art and other teaching credentials. It runs from July 1, 2019 through June 30, 2022 and costs the district nothing.

vendor.name: Academy of Art University, School of Education

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Memorandum of Understanding and Interagency Agreement - District and Academy of Art University, School of Art Education -Talent/Human Resources Department

enrichment.headline: Partners with Saint Mary's College on teacher, counselor and psychologist training at no cost
enrichment.summary: The district signs a memorandum of understanding (MOU) with Saint Mary's College of California for an intern partnership program, student teaching, and internships for school counselors, educational therapists, school psychologists and administrators. It runs from July 1, 2019 through June 30, 2022 and costs the district nothing.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Memorandum of Understanding and Agreement - District and Saint Mary's College of California - Talent/Human Resources Department

enrichment.headline: Partners with Trellis Education on a two-year STEM teacher pathway funded by a state residency grant
enrichment.summary: The district signs a memorandum of understanding (MOU) with Trellis Education for the STEM Teacher Pathway and Mentor Fellow Project, running July 1, 2019 through June 30, 2021. District funding comes from the California Teacher Credentialing (CTC) Residency Grant as pass-through money. The text does not state a dollar amount.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Memorandum of Understanding - District STEM Teacher Pathway and Mentor Fellow Project 2019-2021 - District and Trellis Education - Talent/Human Resources Department

enrichment.headline: Renews UC Berkeley's teacher and school staff training partnership at no district cost
enrichment.summary: The district signs a memorandum of understanding (MOU) with the University of California, Berkeley Graduate School of Education for intern partnership and practica programs for teaching, administrative and pupil personnel service credentials. It runs from July 1, 2019 through June 30, 2020 with no district funding.

vendor.name: Regents of the University of California, Berkeley Graduate School of Education

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Memorandum of Understanding - University of California, Berkeley, Graduate School of Education - Intern Partnership and Practica Programs for K-12 Teaching - Talent/Human Resources Department

enrichment.headline: Creates job descriptions for Analyst, Position Control and Senior Executive Director, Accounting
enrichment.summary: The Board adopts a resolution creating job descriptions for two positions: Analyst, Position Control and Senior Executive Director, Accounting. The text does not state a dollar amount.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Creating Job Descriptions - Analyst, Position Control and Senior Executive Director, Accounting - Talent/Human Resources Department

enrichment.headline: Accepts an $85,000 City of Oakland grant for wellness services at Oakland International High School
enrichment.summary: The district accepts $85,000 from the City of Oakland's KIDS FIRST! Oakland Fund for Children and Youth. It supports more than 357 newly arrived immigrant high school students a year with on-campus wellness services, help for high-risk youth, leadership training and restorative justice. The grant covers July 1, 2019 through June 30, 2020.

vendor.name: City of Oakland - KIDS FIRST! Oakland Fund for Children and Youth

items.fundingSource: City of Oakland - KIDS FIRST! Oakland Fund for Children and Youth

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Grant Agreement - City of Oakland - KIDS FIRST! Oakland Fund for Children and Youth - Oakland International High School

enrichment.headline: Pays Peralta Community College District up to $419,583.72 to run Gateway to College at Laney
enrichment.summary: The district contracts with Peralta Community College District to operate Gateway to College, an alternative high school program on the Laney College campus, for the 2019-2020 school year. The amount is capped at $419,583.72.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Agreement - Gateway to College - Laney Alternative High School - School Year 2019-2020 - High School Network

enrichment.headline: Pays Bay Area Community Resources up to $199,864 to run Madison Park Academy's after-school program
enrichment.summary: The district signs a memorandum of understanding (MOU) with Bay Area Community Resources to lead the After School Program at Madison Park Academy Upper Campus. Services include program coordination, math intervention, homework support, student supervision and enrichment. It runs from August 1, 2019 through July 31, 2020.

items.fundingSource: After School Education and Safety (ASES) Grant; 21st Century Community Learning Centers Grant; After School Education and Safety (ASES) Kids Code Grant

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.summary: The Board adopts its calendar of agenda items for Board meetings from August 2019 through June 2020. It also lets the Board President make further changes to the calendar unless the Board decides otherwise.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.headline: Ratifies the Board President's appointment of a new member to the 7-11 Committee
enrichment.summary: The Board ratifies the Board President's appointment of Eve Stewart to the 7-11 Committee, effective August 29, 2019. She succeeds Eric Johnson and serves the unexpired term ending April 14, 2021.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
